Maya (CS): heads up — a handful of EU onboarding customers are reporting increased 5xxs for embeddings ingest since ~04:05 UTC. getting inbound support tickets.
Diego (CS): thanks. any idea on impact window / severity? priority customers?
Rina (Eng): looks like rerank service returning fallback path after a memory pressure spike in one pod group. affects ~7% of onboarding traffic in eu-west.
Omar (SRE): created INC-2026-1889 and hit escalation. collector alerts trending up.
Maya (CS): ok need short public-safe note we can paste to customers now. keep it non-technical but accurate; include ETA and reassurance about no data loss.
Diego (CS): drafting: ```Hi — we9re investigating an issue causing intermittent errors for some EU onboarding flows. Our engineers have identified a degraded component and are performing a rollback while we monitor. No documents are lost; queued items will finish indexing once service is healthy. Expect recovery within ~25-40 minutes. We9ll share an RCA and next steps within 24 hours. Sorry for the disruption.```
Rina (Eng): change "degraded component" -> "a rerank worker group encountering memory pressure". add: "we9re disabling the canary that rolled earlier today."
Diego (CS): updated draft applied.
Maya (CS): good — I9ll send to impacted list and DM our top-5 with a tailored note and credit offer. Diego can you paste the quick troubleshooting steps to send to customers who reply?
Diego (CS): snippet for support: ```If you see failures: 1) Retry after 10 minutes; 2) Include request-id header when contacting support; 3) If ingestion backlog persists after 1 hour, reply to this thread.```
Omar (SRE): rollback executed at 04:29 UTC; error rate falling. monitoring panels show steady recovery over last 3 minutes.
IncidentBot: INC-2026-1889 update: rollback complete by Omar at 04:29 UTC; severity -> partial, recovery ongoing.
Rina (Eng): disabling canary and adding a patch to tokenization lib to prevent the leak. will keep canary off until QA signs off.
Maya (CS): sending initial note now and scheduling a 1pm CET office hour for impacted customers. capturing for RCA: root cause = memory leak in rerank worker triggered by tokenization edge-case; mitigation = rollback + patch; customer mitigation = queued documents retained.
Diego (CS): thanks — will compile impacted list and open one-off credit approvals for top-5. will log any customer replies here.
Maya (CS): closing for now — customers notified, rollback in place, monitoring. reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
